Veterinarians sometimes estimate a dog's age in years by multiplying its weight in pounds by a constant growth factor that varies depending on the breed. The table below shows the growth factors for several dog breeds. | Dog Breed | Growth
factor | | --- | ---: | | Labrador Retriever | $5$ | | German Shepherd | $5.5$ | | Golden Retriever | $5$ | | Bulldog | $5$ | | Beagle | $4$ | | Boxer | $5.5$ | | Poodle | $4.5$ | | Rottweiler | $6$ | Suppose a Rottweiler and a Poodle each currently weigh $16$ pounds. Which of the following is closest to the difference, in pounds, between their weights $15$ years from now?
